Yes — that's exactly the behavior I was after. When I saved `https://example.com` again, it didn't make a second copy; the count stayed at one, it pointed me right to the Example Domain I'd already saved, and put its title in front of me ready to change. That's what I meant by "take me to the one I already have."

Both of my original worries are now handled the way I wanted. This is good.
